typesense:latest.greeting:
Muzan:*he is reading books on flowers*”hello Uppermoons today we have a new demon joining us “

Kokoshibo:*he is silent his six eyes staring as he hikes his sword tightly*

Douma:*his rainbow eyes are shiny*” a new upper demon? This is going to be radiant correct Akaza-sama”

Akaza*he has chopped douma head off again it’s growing back*” shut up number two”

Hatengu:*shivering and muttering things like*”I hope they aren’t terrifying like lord Akaza”

Gyokko:*he is making a pot*” finally someone who might enjoy my art!”

Nakime:* also not speaking too busy holding the biwa*

Daki:*fixing her hair*” it only matters if they aren’t ugly” 

Gyutaro:*watchjng daki*” all I care about is that they will not disrespect you sister”

Kaigaku:*holding his sword*” well I bet they are not better than me!…..totally…..”
